## Internal confirmed Xero preparation

This workflow is not connected to an AI agent. It accepts only a UUID action that the deterministic confirmation workflow has already consumed for the same session. The stored proposal binds the exact review run, capture tenant and organisation, and sorted suggestion/hash pairs.

Every eligible row is compare-and-set claimed before its Xero request. Each request contains one BankTransaction and a stable Xero Idempotency-Key. Only the claim owner may persist the outcome; deterministic references recover a create whose response was lost. Nothing here reconciles a bank line.

const input = $('Effective Read Connection').first().json;
return [{ json: { ...input, response: { ok: false, error: { code: input.readProblem === 'organisation-mismatch' ? 'XERO_ORGANISATION_MISMATCH' : 'READ_NOT_CONNECTED', message: input.readProblem === 'organisation-mismatch' ? 'The read-only and write credentials point at different Xero organisations, so nothing was created.' : 'The read-only Xero catalogue could not be rechecked, so nothing was created.' }, nextStep: 'The accepted suggestions are still saved. Fix only the Xero (read-only) credential and check again; do not retry preparation until both credentials refer to the same organisation.' } } }];

const selected = $('Plan Preparation Lease').first().json;
return (selected.toCreate ?? []).map((entry) => ({ json: { ...selected, ...entry } }));
